cards.ex: Can I help you find something? — I'm just looking, thanks.
I browsed the shop for an hour. → This jacket was a real bargain! (browse the web, a bargain = 득템)
Let's meet at six. — Sounds like a plan!

cards.ko: 몹시 먹고 싶다 / 긴장을 풀고 쉬다
cards.ex: I'm craving pizza. → I unwind with a movie on Fridays. (crave + 음식, unwind after work)
There's coffee in the kitchen. Help yourself.

quiz.q: Can I help you? — No thanks, I'm ___ .
quiz.note: I'm just looking = 그냥 구경 중이에요. 점원이 말 걸 때 정석 답!

quiz.q: Only 10,000 won for this coat? What a ___ !
quiz.note: a bargain = 싸게 잘 산 것. 동사로는 '흥정하다'.
Sounds like a plan = 좋아, 그렇게 하자. Sounds good보다 조금 더 맞장구 느낌.

quiz.q: After a long week, I just want to ___ at home.
quiz.note: unwind = 긴장 풀고 쉬다. relax와 비슷, 일 끝나고 자주 써요.

quiz.q: There are snacks on the table. ___ !
quiz.note: Help yourself = 마음껏 드세요. 손님한테 권할 때 딱.

cards.ex: Can we talk tomorrow? I'm swamped today.
It was a hectic week. → Sales have been sluggish. (a hectic schedule, feel sluggish = 몸이 축 처지다)
You look tired. Take it easy this weekend.

cards.ko: 큰맘 먹고 돈 쓰다 / 검소한, 알뜰한
cards.ex: I splurged on a nice dinner. → He's very frugal with money. (splurge on N, frugal = 아껴 쓰는)
Don't wait two hours for that café. It's not worth it.

quiz.q: Sorry, I can't make lunch. I'm totally ___ with work.
quiz.note: be swamped (with work) = 일에 파묻히다. busy보다 훨씬 생생해요.

quiz.q: Moving day was so ___ — boxes everywhere!
quiz.note: hectic = 정신없이 바쁜. a hectic day/week로 자주.
Take it easy = 쉬엄쉬엄 해. 헤어질 때 '잘 가' 인사로도 써요.

quiz.q: For my birthday, I ___ on a new watch.
quiz.note: splurge on N = 큰맘 먹고 지르다. 반대 성향은 frugal.

quiz.q: Driving there takes three hours for a 20-minute meeting. ___ .
quiz.note: It's not worth it = 할 가치가 없어. worth 뒤에 it 꼭!

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on the new project this week.
Be wary of deals that look too good. → They charged a hefty fee. (wary of N, a hefty price = 꽤 큰 금액)
He told a joke at the funeral. He really can't read the room.
That restaurant is overrated. → The smell lingered for days. (overrated ↔ underrated, linger = 쉽게 안 사라지다)
The project isn't working. It's time to cut our losses.

quiz.q: Nobody wants to speak first, so I'll ___ .
quiz.note: get the ball rolling = 첫 발을 떼다. 회의 시작할 때 자주.

quiz.q: Investors are ___ of companies with too much debt.
quiz.note: wary of N = ~을 경계하는. cautious보다 '의심'이 섞인 느낌.

quiz.q: He kept talking about money while everyone was sad. He couldn't ___ .
quiz.note: read the room = 분위기 파악. 못 하면 can't read the room.

quiz.q: Everyone loves that movie, but honestly, I think it's ___ .
The shop lost money for three years, so they decided to ___ and close it.
quiz.note: cut one's losses = 더 손해 보기 전에 그만두다.
